name: Calcine Volcanique
description: Gardien du Brasier Sacré protégeant la flamme éternelle des ancêtres qui confère une résistance au feu aux alliés.

subject.archetype: Mutant Aberration – Fire‑Guardian of the Sacred Ember (Calcine Volcanique)

loadout.armor_outfit: Tribal ash‑wrapped garments, rusted anti‑radiation tarp cape, bone‑studded collars, charred leather gauntlets, asymmetric metal plates fused to the torso with exposed, rotting flesh, and a grotesque extra limb holding a sacred brazier.
loadout.arsenal: Relic plasma cannon grafted into the forearm, a handheld sacred flame‑brazier wreathed in molten metal, a small nuclear warhead carried as a venerated relic pendant, and chains of irradiated bone fused to the wrist.

attitude.behavior: Standing upright, the extra arm raised high, gripping the blazing brazier aloft; flames lick the asymmetrical torso, ash swirl around the legs, the posture radiates protective dominance.
attitude.emotion: Fierce, fanatical devotion to the ancestral flame; an intense, pain‑filled resolve to shield allies from fire, underscored by a cold, grotesque stare of radioactive yellow eyes.

palette_names.name: Sickly Flesh (mottled beige‑brown)
palette_names.role: Primary body tones, base skin and ash‑covered fabric

palette_names.name: Ash Brown (charred earth)
palette_names.role: Background ash, ground debris, tattered clothing

palette_names.name: Rusted Metal Gray
palette_names.role: Armor plates, relics, metal grafted to flesh

palette_names.name: Radioactive Yellow
palette_names.role: Tumors, glowing eyes, subtle toxic accents

palette_names.name: Electric Violet
palette_names.role: High‑tech relic weapon energy, plasma core glow

palette_names.name: Pure White
palette_names.role: Sharp highlights on the flawless relic weapon surfaces

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Central flame as primary light source with volumetric ash fog, strong rim light from the relic plasma cannon, reflective metallic surfaces catching orange and violet hues; cinematic backlighting emphasizing silhouette.
color_and_light.mood: Menacing yet reverent, a blend of horror and sacred awe; protective ferocity dominates the atmosphere.

scenography.setting: Scorched ancient temple built from rusted steel beams, fused bone walls, a pit of glowing embers at the center, ash‑laden stone floor with cracks, remnants of high‑tech consoles half‑buried in debris.
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Swirling ash storm, flickering flame particles, heat‑haze distortion, faint radioactive mist, occasional spark bursts from the relic weapon, ambient dust illuminated by the sacred flame.
